ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: On the gray background in the figure there is a centered white diamond “◇”; a black horizontal arrow passes through this structure from left to right; the left side of the arrow is marked “1,” and the right side of the arrow is marked “2,” indicating that the material reaches 2 from 1 after passing through the link represented by the diamond. raw_record.question_text:
Read the figure and answer the question.

<image1>

If this figure is a partial schematic diagram of the material cycle of the lithosphere, and “◇” represents the action of “remelting and regeneration,” then what does 2 in the figure represent?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中灰底上有一个居中的白色菱形“◇”，一条水平箭头由左向右穿过结构，左侧箭段附近标有1，右侧箭段附近标有2，表示沿箭头由1经过菱形所代表的环节到达2。读题可知该图是岩石圈物质循环局部示意图，且“◇”表示“重熔再生”作用。按岩石圈物质循环，原有岩石经重熔再生进入岩浆活动系统，随后形成岩浆岩；因此图中右侧的2应判为“岩浆岩”。
